newsitem.title: SPAIN: Golf-Australia's Norman charges to the top.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Australia's Norman charges to the top.

text.p: Australian Greg Norman is poised to regain the world top ranking in some style after charging into the third round lead at the Spanish Open on Saturday.
Norman, 42, lost his world top ranking to American Tom Lehman last Sunday after a record 96-week spell but can probably reclaim it with a top-10 finish at La Moraleja on Sunday.
And after he mastered a windy day better than all his rivals for a four-under-par 68, he seems certain to achieve it easily.
